logicalRegionName.source: explicit resolved query parameter, no default entity

output_grain: one vdcName value bucket in UNION of scoped VM_NOVA/VOLUME/GAUSSDB_NODE; NULL and empty string are distinct buckets; name buckets do not assert distinct VDC owner identities
scope_propagation: explicit equal logicalRegionName on all four APIs, repeated in each of three SQL resource scans; VM.flavorId=FLAVOR.id AND same logicalRegionName
one_to_many: FLAVOR unique id required, VM LEFT JOIN FLAVOR preserves unknown; VM CPU, volume capacity, and node counts aggregate independently before NULL-safe joins; no SUM(DISTINCT value)

cpu_policy.accepted_value: trimmed ASCII nonnegative integer text, bounded aggregate <=1e15
cpu_policy.known_vcpu: sum known core values; 0 for no VM
cpu_policy.unknown_cpu_vm_count: VM count with no matched flavor or NULL/empty/dirty vcpuSize
cpu_policy.total_vcpu_if_complete: known_vcpu only when unknown_cpu_vm_count=0, otherwise NULL; missing FLAVOR rows do not remove VMs

capacity_policy.unit: unconverted source VOLUME.size units; source documentation says only capacity
capacity_policy.accepted_value: trimmed ASCII nonnegative decimal text with at most one dot, at least one digit; no comma/exponent/sign/unit suffix; bounded aggregate <=1e15; SQLite REAL precision
capacity_policy.total_volume_size_if_complete: known sum only when unknown count is zero, otherwise NULL
capacity_policy.C_decision: GB/GiB/unit equivalence and official grading expected columns remain unresolved; do not label this source-unit sum GB

null_empty_missing.vdcName: NULL and missing per-row value enter NULL bucket if table schema exists; empty string separate; no synthetic tenant or VDC identity
null_empty_missing.optional_value_missing: unknown when table column schema exists; missing required column across payload fails preflight
null_empty_missing.identity_region: missing identity, wrong/missing region, or duplicate identity fails entire snapshot

true_empty_vs_failure.successful_schema_proven_empty: empty union emits zero rows; a VDC with no resource of one type gets known 0 for that type
true_empty_vs_failure.failed_unknown: reject entire operation, never COALESCE failure to zero
true_empty_vs_failure.official_loader: _empty placeholder is insufficient schema; official executor not modified; B must prepare schema-preserving tables under allowed runtime boundary or refuse empty snapshots

pagination: requires stable integer totalNum/pageSize/totalPageNo, consecutive currentPage, all pages with exact row lengths, unique IDs; empty response accepts totalPageNo 0 or 1; truncation/unstable counts/duplicates/missing objList reject; snapshot-consistent content changes without total change cannot be proven locally
long_request: no parameter or SQL truncation; exact serialized_plan_bytes returned; B must apply formal <=4KB/depth4 request policy before execution; excessive plans remain blocked, not silently reduced
unsupported_obligations: additional outputs or scope not in schema
integration: B alone wires matcher/system. Call build, validate complete schema-backed pages before running SQL. This local validation helper is a contract and not official executor replacement. No question text or test identifiers accepted.
